name: Cinnamon Soy Yogurt Oat Bowl
ingredients: ¾ cup plain unsweetened high-protein soy yogurt
steps: Stir oats, soy yogurt and soy milk together in a bowl.
Fold in chia and cinnamon; rest 5 minutes to soften the oats.
Add diced apple tossed with lemon juice.
Top with pumpkin seeds and serve, or refrigerate overnight for a softer texture.
note: Choose unsweetened soy yogurt with a protein-rich label. No nuts, dairy or added sugar.
